Karakteristikat e Prones:
– Apartament 3+1
– Rruga Xhanfize Keko, Porcelan prane TV Klan
– Pallat ne ndertim
– Kati 2 banim
– Siperfaqja e Bruto 127.36m²
– Siperfaqja e Neto 113m²
– Cmimi 203,000 Euro
Shitet apartamet 3+1 i cili ndodhet ne katin e 2 banim te nje pallati te ri me ashensor ne Porcelan prane TV Klan. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 127.36m² dhe organizohet ne sallon ndenje, ambient gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkoni. Apartamenti eshte i orientuar Veri-Perendim.
Residenca ”Porcelan3” ndodhet ne nje zone e cila i ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme, si dyqane, market, farmaci, shkolla kopshte etj. Rezidenca eshte me pishine brenda ne kompleks dhe prane saj kalon Unaza e Madhe.
Pallati perfundon ne 2026. Nuk shitet me financim kredie.
Per me shume informacione ose per nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e agjencise imobiliare!
title_en: Apartment 3+1+2+Blk for sale, Porcelan - Residence "Porcelan 3", 203,000 Euros
description_en: Property characteristics: - 3+1 apartment - Xhanfize Keko street, Porcelan near TV Klan - Building under construction - 2nd residential floor - Gross area 127.36m² - Net area 113m² - Price 203,000 Euro 3+1 apartments for sale, located on the 2nd residential floor of a new building with elevator in Porcelan near TV Clan. The apartment has a total area of ​​127.36m² and is organized into a living room, kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is oriented North-West. The "Porcelan3" residence is located in an area that offers all the necessary facilities, such as shops, markets, pharmacies, kindergartens, etc. The residence has a swimming pool inside the complex and the Great Ring Road passes by it. The building will be completed in 2026. Not for sale with loan financing. For more information or for a visit to the property, contact the number of the real estate agency!
